entities.summary: The President of Azad Kashmir, officially the President of the State of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, is the head of state of Azad Kashmir, a territory administered by Pakistan. The president is the nominal head of executive and the legislative assembly, serving as a ceremonial figurehead. He is constitutionally bound to act on advice of the prime minister and the cabinet.
